indication: CLDN18.2+ gastric/GEJ adenocarcinoma and metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma
line: 2L+ (PDAC escalation: no line limit; expansion ≤2 prior lines; a 1L chemo-combination cohort also exists)
biomarker: CLDN18.2+ by central IHC; monotherapy escalation cutoff ≥1+ membranous staining
design: Phase 1/1b dose escalation and expansion; ASP2138 monotherapy (SC/IV) and combinations with chemotherapy or pembrolizumab
intervention_dosing: SC or IV, dose per escalation cohort
inclusion_match_notes: The PDAC monotherapy arm takes patients who progressed on, refused, or lack standard options with no line limit, which covers a FOLFIRINOX-resistant recurrence four months off adjuvant therapy. The ≥1+ escalation cutoff sits far below this tumor's 2+/3+ in 60%, though central IHC on submitted tissue is still required and staining the recurrence rather than the archival primary would be safer. ECOG 0 and measurable disease on restaging complete the eligibility picture; gastric interim data (12-week DCR 41.7% at ≥420 μg) were shown at ESMO 2025 with the PDAC readout still pending.

indication: CLDN18.2+ gastric and pancreatic cancer (North America)
biomarker: CLDN18.2+ by sponsor IHC assay; satri-cel program threshold ≥2+ intensity in ≥40% of cells — the patient's 60% at 2+/3+ clears it
design: Phase 1b/2 open-label, satri-cel (CT041) autologous CLDN18.2 CAR-T after lymphodepletion, up to 3 infusions
inclusion_match_notes: Every biologic axis lines up: the 60% 2+/3+ stain clears the ≥40% × ≥2+ program threshold, one prior line satisfies the PAAD entry rule, and ECOG 0 fits. The trial stopped enrolling, which is what caps the rating; satri-cel's June 2026 NMPA approval in 2L+ gastric cancer makes a sponsor conversation about PDAC access worth having anyway. Prior CAR-T/TCR within a year and unstable CNS disease are the main exclusions to watch.

comparator: physician's choice (paclitaxel, irinotecan, apatinib, or anti-PD-1)
indication: Advanced gastric/GEJ adenocarcinoma, CLDN18.2+, ≥2 prior lines (China)
biomarker: CLDN18.2 IHC-positive, HER2-negative
design: Randomized open-label phase 2 (CT041-ST-01), satri-cel vs treatment of physician's choice
inclusion_match_notes: Included for evidence, not enrollment: the randomized win over physician's choice in CLDN18.2+ gastric cancer is the anchor for the whole CLDN18.2 CAR-T strategy and drove the June 2026 China approval. The patient's tumor type differs, so this row supports mechanism rather than eligibility. Grade ≥3 TEAEs in 99% of treated patients (mostly hematologic from lymphodepletion) is the toxicity context the board should weigh.

effect_size: PR in case 1; target-lesion complete response of lung metastases in case 2
indication: CLDN18.2+ metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma (post-standard-therapy)
biomarker: CLDN18.2 IHC 2+ in 70% (case 1) and 3+ in 60% (case 2)
design: Research letter reporting two metastatic PDAC patients treated with CT041 within NCT04581473 and NCT03874897
sponsor: CARsgen Therapeutics / Peking University Cancer Hospital
inclusion_match_notes: Two patients is thin evidence, but case 2 carried CLDN18.2 3+ in 60% of cells — almost exactly this patient's profile — and had target lung lesions clear after infusion with grade 2 CRS controlled by tocilizumab. That is the most directly matched published efficacy signal in the whole CLDN18.2 file. Evidence row only; the underlying Chinese trials are not an enrollment path.

indication: CLDN18.2+ advanced solid tumors including PDAC and gastric/GEJ; monotherapy and chemo combinations
biomarker: CLDN18.2+ by central pathology; expression tier required varies by cohort (dose-optimization cohorts preferentially enroll moderate-to-high expressers)
design: First-in-human phase 1 dose escalation/expansion/optimization of IBI343, including PDAC cohorts and FOLFIRINOX/mFOLFOX combinations
inclusion_match_notes: PDAC is a named cohort and US sites are open, but the active cohorts skew first-line and the optimization cohorts preferentially take moderate-to-high expressers on the sponsor assay, so where a 60% 2+/3+ archival result lands needs sponsor confirmation. Anti-CLDN18.2-naïve status and ECOG 0 fit. The gastric phase 1 read out in Nat Med 2025 (PMID 40670773), and the drug is in phase 3 in both gastric and pancreatic cancer.

indication: Previously treated, CLDN18.2+ pancreatic cancer
biomarker: CLDN18.2-positive per sponsor assay (cutoff not stated in the registry record)
design: Randomized double-blind phase 3, IBI343 6 mg/kg Q3W vs placebo
inclusion_match_notes: A phase 3 built exactly for this situation: previously treated PDAC selected on CLDN18.2, and the recurrence four months after adjuvant FOLFIRINOX reads as previously treated under most conventions. Every listed site is in China, so travel willingness gets tested here and sponsor acceptance of an international patient is unverified. The registry's ECOG '0 or 2' line looks like a typo for 0-1 or 0-2; the sponsor cutoff for CLDN18.2 positivity needs to be checked against the 60% 2+/3+ archival result.

indication: CLDN18.2+ advanced pancreatic cancer, first-line
biomarker: CLDN18.2-positive by pathological testing
design: Phase 2 single-arm, IBI343 + gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel
inclusion_match_notes: First-line design in advanced PDAC: the patient has had no systemic therapy for the recurrence, so a 1L slot is arguable, but protocols in this position usually specify a minimum interval since adjuvant chemotherapy and this record does not say. China-only sites. The GnP backbone also asks the neuropathy question after ten oxaliplatin-containing cycles — grade the neuropathy before considering any taxane-bearing arm.

indication: CLDN18.2+ advanced solid tumors: gastric/GEJ, PDAC, esophageal
line: 2L+ (≥1 prior line in the advanced/metastatic setting)
biomarker: CLDN18.2+ by central IHC (cutoff protocol-defined)
design: Phase 1/2 dose escalation and expansion of AZD5863 monotherapy
inclusion_match_notes: PDAC is a named indication with US sites recruiting, and the tumor's 2+/3+ in 60% should satisfy a central-IHC positivity call. The catch is line accounting: entry requires ≥1 prior line in the advanced/metastatic setting, and whether a recurrence four months after adjuvant FOLFIRINOX counts is a site-level ruling this registry text does not settle. Unresolved toxicity ≥ grade 2 is exclusionary, so the ungraded oxaliplatin neuropathy needs documenting before screening.

indication: CLDN18.2-expressing gastroesophageal, pancreatic, and other solid tumors
line: 2L (≥1 and ≤2 prior lines for advanced disease; pan-tumor cohort unrestricted)
biomarker: Tumor expresses CLDN18.2; tissue required for central biomarker assessment
design: Phase 1/2 dose escalation and expansion of ASP546C
inclusion_match_notes: Astellas's CLDN18.2 ADC with pancreatic adenocarcinoma named at entry and US sites open. The ≥1-prior-line-for-advanced-disease requirement raises the same post-adjuvant line-counting question as the other 2L protocols, and central tissue submission is required, which the recurrence biopsy would serve. A ≤2-line cap means this door closes if more therapy accrues first.

indication: Advanced solid tumors after standard therapy, including PDAC and gastric cohorts with CLDN18.2 expression
biomarker: CLDN18.2 expression confirmed on tumor tissue (expansion cohorts)
design: Phase 1/2 dose escalation and expansion of XNW27011, Q3W
inclusion_match_notes: Enrollment is closed, which is the limiting fact; the row stays because Astellas licensing this ADC mid-trial signals the program continues and later cohorts may reopen. Eligibility as written fit the case: post-standard-therapy PDAC with confirmed CLDN18.2 expression and ECOG up to 2.

indication: CLDN18.2+ advanced PDAC, gastric/GEJ, and biliary tract cancer
biomarker: Documented positive CLDN18.2 expression
design: Phase 1/2 dose escalation and expansion of AZD4360
inclusion_match_notes: PDAC-inclusive CLDN18.2 ADC that matched on biomarker, indication, and ECOG, but the study is not currently enrolling. Worth tracking for reopened cohorts since AstraZeneca is running it alongside AZD5863 and AZD0901; the same post-adjuvant line-counting question applies if it reopens.

indication: CLDN18.2-expressing advanced solid tumours: PDAC, gastric/GEJ, biliary tract
line: 1L/2L+ (max 2 prior lines for advanced disease; 1L cohort requires ≥6 months from adjuvant chemotherapy)
biomarker: CLDN18.2-positive (sponsor assay); archival sample or fresh biopsy
design: Phase 2 multi-cohort, AZD0901 (CMG901) monotherapy and chemo combinations
inclusion_match_notes: The 1L path is closed outright — it requires ≥6 months from the last adjuvant dose and this recurrence came at four — while the previously-treated path needs the recurrence to count as progression after a prior regimen, which most sites would grant. Two protocol details bite here: peripheral neuropathy ≥ grade 2 is exclusionary (ungraded after ten FOLFIRINOX cycles), and no US sites are listed, so this means travel to Australia, Canada, Japan, or Europe. Archival tissue is acceptable for the CLDN18.2 call.

indication: Gastric/GEJ adenocarcinoma, PDAC, and biliary tract cancer
biomarker: CLDN18.2 expression assessed on FFPE (fresh biopsy preferred, archival accepted); no cutoff stated in registry
design: Phase 1/2, spevatamig monotherapy and chemo/checkpoint combinations including a PDAC + GnP substudy
inclusion_match_notes: A recruiting US program with a dedicated PDAC chemotherapy substudy and orphan/fast-track designations in pancreatic cancer. The registry hides the line requirements and the CLDN18.2 scoring rule, so the rating stays partial until the sponsor confirms both; archival tissue is explicitly acceptable, which helps while the recurrence is unbiopsied. No prior CLDN18.2- or CD47-directed therapy is allowed — true for this patient — and the GnP backbone again raises the ungraded-neuropathy question.

effect_size: ORR 16% in CLDN18.2+ gastroesophageal cancer at ≥5 mg/kg
indication: CLDN18.2-positive advanced solid tumors (efficacy population: gastroesophageal cancer)
biomarker: CLDN18.2-positive; responders spanned 11% to 100% tumor-cell expression
design: First-in-human phase 1 dose escalation of givastomig monotherapy; trial continues with 1L chemo/checkpoint combination arms
inclusion_match_notes: The published escalation shows single-agent activity across a wide CLDN18.2 expression range, including tumors staining well below this patient's 60%, with no MTD reached — useful mechanism evidence for a 4-1BB-conditional approach that avoids CD3-engager toxicity. Development is centered on gastroesophageal cancer and the ongoing combination cohorts are 1L gastric, so a PDAC route through this program is not visible today.

indication: CLDN18.2+ unresectable/metastatic gastric, GEJ, esophageal, or pancreatic cancer
line: 2L+ (adjuvant/neoadjuvant counts as a line if progression within 6 months of completion)
biomarker: CLDN18.2-positive per sponsor assay
design: Phase 1 dose escalation/expansion of LB1908 autologous CLDN18.2 CAR-T
inclusion_match_notes: This protocol spells out the convention the whole 2L question turns on: neoadjuvant/adjuvant therapy counts as a prior regimen when progression lands within 6 months of completion, which makes this patient previously-treated at four months. Pancreatic cancer is a named indication and toxicity carve-outs even tolerate residual neuropathy. Enrollment is paused, which is the only thing keeping this from a strong rating — worth a site call to ask about reopening.

indication: CLDN18.2+ metastatic solid tumors
line: 2L+ (≥2 prior lines phase 1; 2-4 prior lines phase 2)
biomarker: CLDN18.2-positive by central laboratory
design: Phase 1/2 (TACTIC-3), TAC01-CLDN18.2 autologous T-cell antigen coupler cells after lymphodepletion
intervention: TAC01-CLDN18.2 (T-cell antigen coupler engineered T cells; non-CAR platform)
inclusion_match_notes: A biomarker-defined basket — any incurable CLDN18.2-expressing tumor without a standard targeted option enrolls regardless of line count, which suits a PDAC patient exactly. Currently not enrolling; the phase 1 wanted ≥2 prior lines, which the post-adjuvant recurrence only satisfies under the counts-as-a-line convention. Modality is a TAC-engineered T cell, not a CAR, though the practical profile (apheresis, lymphodepletion, CRS risk) is similar.

indication: Advanced cancer including gastric, GEJ, and pancreas cancer
biomarker: CLDN18.2-directed; expression requirement per protocol (not stated in registry)
design: First-in-human phase 1 of TORL-2-307-ADC
inclusion_match_notes: Pancreas cancer is on the label of this first-in-human ADC but enrollment is closed and the registry discloses neither line rules nor an expression cutoff. Tracked as pipeline context; a companion monotherapy antibody trial (TORL-2-307-MAB, NCT05159440) is in the same state.

effect_size: primary OS endpoint not met (topline, October 2025)
indication: CLDN18.2-positive (≥75% of cells 2+/3+) metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma, first-line
biomarker: CLDN18.2 ≥75% of tumor cells at moderate-to-strong membranous staining by central IHC — the patient's 60% fails this cutoff
design: Randomized phase 2 (GLEAM), zolbetuximab + gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel vs GnP alone; n=393 enrolled
inclusion_match_notes: Kept as the decision-relevant negative on the zolbetuximab path: the patient fails the ≥75% CDx cutoff at 60%, the trial is closed, and even in expressers above that bar the combination missed its OS endpoint in first-line PDAC. Off-label zolbetuximab therefore has neither an eligibility basis nor an efficacy basis here — the CLDN18.2 strategy should route through CAR-T, engagers, and ADCs with lower cutoffs instead. A small companion study with mFOLFIRINOX (NCT06396091, also ≥75%) is likewise closed.

indication: CLDN18.2-expressing advanced gastric/GEJ cancer (≥20% of cells at 2+/3+)
biomarker: CLDN18.2 ≥20% of tumor cells at IHC 2+/3+
design: Phase 1 dose escalation/expansion of EO-3021 monotherapy
inclusion_match_notes: Discontinued program, kept so the board sees the CLDN18.2 ADC field's failure alongside its actives: Elevation halted EO-3021 in March 2025 after a 22.2% ORR in gastric expansion cohorts underwhelmed against competitors. Instructive for expectations-setting on the ADC class at moderate expression levels; no enrollment implication for this case.

indication: CLDN18.2-positive locally advanced unresectable or metastatic pancreatic cancer, first-line
biomarker: CLDN18.2-positive by central IHC (cutoff not stated in registry)
design: Phase 1b/2, ANO31905 (500-800 μg/kg Q2W) + gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel
intervention_dosing: 500 or 800 μg/kg IV D1/D15 per cycle + GnP
inclusion_match_notes: The only US-recruiting CLDN18.2×CD3 + chemotherapy study built specifically for first-line PDAC, with the same molecule (QLS31905) already in a Chinese phase 3 and 1L pancreatic combination data at ASCO 2026. The open question is whether a recurrence four months after adjuvant FOLFIRINOX qualifies as first-line under this protocol — the registry does not state an interval rule — plus the usual central CLDN18.2 call. GnP backbone: grade the residual neuropathy first.

indication: CLDN18.2-positive pancreatic cancer, first-line (China)
line: 1L (no prior systemic therapy for unresectable/metastatic disease)
biomarker: CLDN18.2-positive (sponsor assay)
design: Randomized double-blind phase 3, QLS31905 + GnP vs placebo + GnP
inclusion_match_notes: A registrational CLDN18.2 engager trial in exactly this tumor type; the patient has technically had no systemic therapy for unresectable/metastatic disease, so the 1L criterion reads as met, though sites may still apply an interval-since-adjuvant rule the registry omits. All sites are in China. If travel there is off the table in practice, the US ANO31905 study (NCT07444541) is the same molecule.

indication: CLDN18.2-positive (≥40% of cells ≥2+) unresectable/metastatic pancreatic cancer, first-line
biomarker: CLDN18.2 ≥40% of tumor cells with membrane staining ≥2+ by central IHC — the patient's 60% at 2+/3+ clears this
design: Randomized double-blind phase 3, FG-M108 + GnP vs placebo + GnP
inclusion_match_notes: The first phase 3 mAb trial in PDAC whose published cutoff (≥40% at ≥2+) this tumor actually clears — a direct answer to the zolbetuximab 75% problem. Not yet recruiting and China-based, and the neoadjuvant/adjuvant clause in the eligibility text is truncated in the registry, so the four-month post-adjuvant interval needs checking against the full protocol. Central re-staining would use the recurrence biopsy tissue.

effect_size: ORR 35% (2L, 300 mg, RAS G12, n=26); median PFS 8.5 and OS 13.1 months
indication: Previously treated advanced RAS-mutated PDAC (phase 1/2 RMC-6236-001; trial still recruiting)
biomarker: RAS G12 mutations (G12R included); PDAC with RAS wild-type also studied at expansion
design: Phase 1/2 dose escalation/optimization of daraxonrasib monotherapy; published PDAC analysis of 168 patients at ≤300 mg
intervention_dosing: 300 mg PO once daily (dose taken forward)
inclusion_match_notes: G12R sits squarely inside the RAS(ON) multi-selective mechanism, prior standard therapy or treatment-naïve status both qualify, and the trial is still recruiting with ECOG 0-1 required — all axes met on the archival NGS alone, though re-confirming the genotype on the recurrence (tissue or ctDNA) is the clean path. The published 2L numbers (ORR 35%, OS 13.1 months) are the strongest efficacy signal in this entire dossier. Grade ≥3 treatment-related events at 30%, mostly rash and GI.

effect_size: median OS 13.2 vs 6.7 months; HR 0.40 (ITT and RAS G12)
indication: Previously treated metastatic PDAC, RAS status documented (91.8% RAS G12-mutant)
biomarker: RAS mutation at codon 12/13/61 documented (mutant or wild-type accepted); patient's G12R qualifies
design: Randomized phase 3 (RASolute 302), daraxonrasib 300 mg QD vs investigator's-choice chemotherapy
inclusion_match_notes: The practice-changing result for this exact population — previously treated metastatic PDAC across RAS G12 variants including G12R — but enrollment completed, so the row is partial on access rather than on biology. With OS doubled (13.2 vs 6.7 months, HR 0.40) and an FDA submission announced, the live questions are expanded access, the recruiting 1L companion RASolute 303 (NCT07491445), and the still-open phase 1/2 (NCT05379985). Eligibility here required metastatic disease; restaging must establish whether this recurrence is metastatic or local-only.

indication: Metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma, first-line (RASolute 303)
line: 1L (metastatic diagnosis ≤6 weeks before consent; no prior systemic therapy in the metastatic setting)
biomarker: Documented RAS mutation status, mutant or wild-type; G12R qualifies
design: Randomized phase 3, daraxonrasib monotherapy and daraxonrasib + GnP vs GnP
inclusion_match_notes: Prior adjuvant FOLFIRINOX does not exclude — only metastatic-setting therapy or prior RAS-targeted therapy does — so if restaging shows metastatic disease this patient walks in as first-line with a documented RAS mutation and ECOG 0. The clock is the constraint: metastatic diagnosis must be within 6 weeks of consent, which makes the biopsy/restaging sequence urgent and screening worth starting in parallel. US, Japan, and Australia sites are recruiting.

indication: RAS-mutated gastrointestinal tumors including PDAC; daraxonrasib + chemotherapy combinations
biomarker: RAS-mutant; the G12D restriction applies only to subprotocols D/E/F, not the daraxonrasib chemo-combination arms
design: Phase 1/2 master protocol, RAS(ON) inhibitors + mFOLFIRINOX, mFOLFOX6, GnP, bevacizumab, or cetuximab
inclusion_match_notes: The combination complement to daraxonrasib monotherapy: PDAC arms pair it with mFOLFIRINOX or GnP at US sites, and the allele gate that would exclude G12R sits only on the zoldonrasib subprotocols. A FOLFIRINOX-containing arm is unattractive after functional FOLFIRINOX failure, so the GnP pairing is the relevant slot; residual neuropathy grading matters for the taxane. ECOG 0-1 and no CNS disease are the other stated gates.

indication: KRAS-mutant solid tumors with PDAC expansion cohorts
line: 2L (PDAC expansion: ≤2 prior advanced-setting lines; neoadjuvant/adjuvant with recurrence ≤6 months counts as one line)
biomarker: KRAS G12V, G12D, G12C, G12R, G12A, or G13D by local testing — G12R is named explicitly
design: Phase 1 dose escalation/expansion of ASP5834 (IV) ± panitumumab
inclusion_match_notes: One of the few protocols that both names G12R and writes down the line-counting rule this case needs: adjuvant chemotherapy with recurrence inside 6 months counts as the one prior line, making the patient cleanly eligible for the PDAC expansion after a gemcitabine- or fluoropyrimidine-based regimen. Local KRAS documentation from the December 2025 NGS satisfies the biomarker gate as written. US sites recruiting.

indication: KRAS-mutant PDAC (any variant), CRC, NSCLC; monotherapy and combinations including GnP
line: 1L-3L (cohort-specific; PDAC 2-3L cohort counts neoadjuvant/adjuvant per protocol rules)
biomarker: Confirmed KRAS mutation, any variant, for PDAC — G12R covered
design: Phase 1 dose escalation/expansion of PF-07934040 alone and with chemotherapy or cetuximab
inclusion_match_notes: Any-variant KRAS eligibility covers G12R and PDAC cohorts span 1L through 3L with a GnP combination, but the study has gone active-not-recruiting, which drops it to watch-list status. A sensory neuropathy ≥ grade 2 exclusion applies if cohorts reopen.

indication: Advanced solid tumors with KRAS alteration
biomarker: KRAS alteration (pan-KRAS; no allele list in registry); prior KRAS/pan-KRAS inhibitor exposure excluded
design: Phase 1/2a dose escalation and expansion of JAB-23E73 monotherapy (US/global protocol; a China counterpart runs as NCT06959615 and a PDAC chemo-combination study as NCT07640295)
inclusion_match_notes: Pan-KRAS eligibility with no stated allele list should admit G12R, and the patient is KRAS-inhibitor-naïve as required; sponsor confirmation that the expansion tumor selection includes PDAC (a metastatic-PDAC combination protocol already exists in China) is the remaining check. ECOG and measurable-disease criteria fit.

indication: Advanced solid tumors with KRAS, HRAS, or NRAS mutations
biomarker: Any KRAS/HRAS/NRAS mutation by local testing — G12R qualifies
design: Phase 1 dose escalation of YL-17231, oral pan-RAS inhibitor
inclusion_match_notes: Broad pan-RAS gate that G12R passes, with US sites listed as recruiting; the caution is registry staleness — the record was last updated April 2025 against a stated October 2025 primary completion, so confirm the study is genuinely still enrolling before counting on it.

indication: KRAS-mutant metastatic PDAC, NSCLC, or CRC
biomarker: KRAS-mutant (allele coverage not itemized in registry); prior KRAS-targeted therapy excluded
design: First-in-human phase 1/2 dose escalation/enrichment/expansion of BLU-924
inclusion_match_notes: Newly opened US first-in-human with PDAC named at entry and a KRAS-inhibitor-naïve requirement the patient meets. The registry does not itemize which KRAS alleles the escalation admits, so G12R coverage needs sponsor confirmation before a screening trip — the BBO-11818 example shows pan-KRAS labels sometimes omit G12R.

indication: Advanced solid tumors with KRAS mutations, including PDAC, NSCLC, CRC
biomarker: Documented KRAS mutation (no allele restriction stated) — G12R admissible as written
design: Phase 1 dose escalation of KST-6051 oral monotherapy
inclusion_match_notes: KRAS-mutant PDAC is a named population, the only biomarker gate is a documented KRAS mutation — satisfied by the December 2025 NGS — and no prior RAS-inhibitor exposure is required-naïve, which fits. Early dose-escalation slots carry sub-therapeutic-dose risk, the standard phase 1 caveat rather than an eligibility problem.

indication: Advanced/metastatic solid tumors with KRAS/NRAS/HRAS mutations
line: 2L+ (adjuvant therapy counts as a line if progression within 6 months of first dose)
biomarker: KRAS/NRAS/HRAS mutation by validated tissue or cfDNA testing; prior pan-RAS(ON) exposure excluded
design: Phase 1 dose escalation of AN9025, an oral pan-RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor (same mechanism class as daraxonrasib)
inclusion_match_notes: Same cyclophilin-A tri-complex mechanism as daraxonrasib, US sites open, and the adjuvant-counts-if-within-6-months convention is written into the protocol, which this recurrence satisfies. Some early cohorts read NSCLC-slanted (an ICI-plus-platinum prior-therapy clause), so which cohorts take PDAC needs a site question; archival tissue within 5 years or a new biopsy is required.

indication: Advanced solid tumors with RAS mutations, PDAC named
biomarker: RAS-mutant (KRAS/NRAS/HRAS, active-state ON inhibitor) — G12R within scope
design: Phase 2 of JYP0015 (ERAS-0015) oral pan-RAS molecular glue
inclusion_match_notes: A pan-RAS(ON) glue already at phase 2 with PDAC in the entry population; mechanism covers G12R. All listed sites are in China, which puts this behind the US pan-RAS options unless the travel offer is meant that literally.

indication: KRAS/NRAS-mutated PDAC and CRC in minimal-residual-disease state after locoregional therapy (AMPLIFY-7P)
biomarker: KRAS/NRAS G12D/G12R/G12V/G12A/G12C/G12S/G13D — G12R in the 7-peptide pool; requires ctDNA positivity or rising tumor markers WITH a negative CT for recurrence
design: Phase 1/2 of ELI-002 7P lymph-node-targeted amphiphile mKRAS vaccine
inclusion_match_notes: The ctDNA-positivity gate the validator flagged is real, but the harder wall is the paired requirement of a recurrence-negative CT — this patient's radiographic pancreatic-body mass is precisely what the protocol screens out, and enrollment has closed besides. The row stays because the G12R-containing vaccine mechanism is validated in this disease and a future MRD window (for instance after successful local therapy of the recurrence) could revive the class.

indication: Resectable/borderline resectable localized PDAC with KRAS G12D/V/R/C/A/S or G13D (MSK, neoadjuvant)
biomarker: One of seven KRAS mutations including G12R; localized disease only, staging negative for metastasis
design: Phase 1, ELI-002 7P + tislelizumab + mFOLFIRINOX before surgery; ≤4 prior neoadjuvant mFOLFIRINOX doses allowed
inclusion_match_notes: Wrong disease state on every axis that matters: this is a pre-surgical protocol for localized treatment-naïve-ish disease capped at four neoadjuvant mFOLFIRINOX doses, while the patient is post-resection, post-ten-cycles, with a recurrent mass and likely vascular invasion that the exclusion list names directly. Kept because the launching agent flagged it and because it shows where the G12R-covering vaccine franchise is moving.

effect_size: T-cell responses above threshold correlated with reduced relapse and death (final analysis, median follow-up 19.7 months)
indication: PDAC (20) and CRC (5) with minimal residual mKRAS disease after locoregional treatment (AMPLIFY-201, ELI-002 2P)
biomarker: mKRAS G12D or G12R — the 2-peptide vaccine covers exactly this patient's allele class
design: Phase 1 single-arm, lymph-node-targeted amphiphile vaccine (G12D/G12R peptides + CpG-7909 adjuvant); final results
endpoint: mKRAS-specific T-cell response; correlation with relapse-free survival
inclusion_match_notes: Direct published proof that G12R-specific T-cell immunity can be raised in PDAC patients and that its magnitude tracks with relapse-free survival — the mechanism anchor for every mKRAS-vaccine row here. The MRD setting does not match a radiographic recurrence, so this informs strategy (vaccination belongs after cytoreduction, not instead of it) rather than enrollment.

indication: Stage IV MMR-proficient CRC and PDAC with vaccine-covered KRAS mutations; maintenance and KRAS-inhibitor-exposed cohorts
biomarker: Tumor expresses one of the pooled vaccine's KRAS mutations (G12R included); MMR-proficient — the patient's MSS status is required here, not exclusionary
design: Phase 1/2, pooled mutant-KRAS long-peptide vaccine with poly-ICLC + balstilimab (anti-PD-1) + botensilimab (Fc-enhanced anti-CTLA-4)
sponsor: Sidney Kimmel Comprehensive Cancer Center (Johns Hopkins)
inclusion_match_notes: G12R is in the peptide pool, MMR-proficiency is an entry requirement rather than a barrier, and the mandatory ECOG 0 — unusual among these trials — is one this patient actually holds. Two practical gates: cohort placement (maintenance after disease control on chemo, or prior KRAS-inhibitor exposure for cohort C, neither of which describes today), and a requirement for lesions amenable to repeat biopsy, which the vascular-invasion question bears on directly. The combination immunotherapy design answers the MSS/TMB-low objection by not relying on single-agent PD-1 biology.

indication: PDAC after one failed treatment (and NSCLC post-anti-PD-1) with KRAS codon 12/13 mutations
biomarker: KRAS codon 12 (12A/C/D/R/S/V) or 13D — G12R named
design: Phase 2, daratumumab (anti-CD38) + TG01 mKRAS vaccine + nivolumab
inclusion_match_notes: A PDAC-specific second-line combination whose KRAS gate names 12R and whose failed-one-prior-treatment requirement the post-adjuvant recurrence plausibly meets, but the study is not currently enrolling. Tracked for reopening; the CD38-depletion-plus-vaccine design is another MSS-compatible immunotherapy route.

indication: Metastatic PDAC, first-line, KRAS G12D-mutant
biomarker: Documented KRAS G12D required — patient is G12R: excluded on allele
design: Randomized phase 3, zoldonrasib + investigator's-choice chemo vs placebo + chemo
inclusion_match_notes: Recorded so nobody routes this patient to the highest-profile 1L KRAS trial in PDAC by mistake: zoldonrasib is G12D-selective and the protocol requires documented G12D, which a G12R tumor fails outright. The same sponsor's daraxonrasib program (RASolute 303, NCT07491445) is the allele-appropriate counterpart.

indication: KRAS-mutant NSCLC, PDAC, CRC and other solid tumors
biomarker: Eligible alleles G12A, G12C, G12D, G12S, G12V — G12R is absent from the list: excluded on allele
design: Phase 1 of BBO-11818 pan-KRAS inhibitor ± pembrolizumab, chemo, cetuximab, or BBO-10203
inclusion_match_notes: The cautionary example for 'pan-KRAS' labels: this eligibility itemizes five G12 alleles and G12R is not one of them, so the patient screens out despite the pan-KRAS billing. Kept precisely to document that every RAS trial in this dossier was checked at codon-and-allele level.

indication: Unresectable/metastatic solid tumors incl. PDAC with KRAS G12D
biomarker: KRAS G12D plus HLA-C*08:02 or HLA-A*11:01/02 required — patient is G12R (HLA untyped): excluded on allele
design: Phase 1 of NT-112 and AZD0240 autologous KRAS G12D TCR-T cells
inclusion_match_notes: TCR-T for mutant KRAS in PDAC exists, but the clinical constructs are G12D- (here) or G12V-restricted, and none targets G12R. Documented as part of the finding that G12R currently has no allele-matched cellular-therapy route — HLA typing (recommended by the biomarker survey) only becomes decision-relevant for this class if a G12R-restricted TCR enters the clinic.

indication: Metastatic/locally advanced PDAC (Anocca TCR-T master protocol)
biomarker: KRAS G12V (ANOC-001/-002) or G12D (ANOC-003) with matching HLA alleles — G12R not covered: excluded on allele
design: Master protocol, gene-edited autologous TCR-T targeting HLA-presented mutant-KRAS peptides, single infusion after Flu/Cy
inclusion_match_notes: A PDAC-dedicated TCR-T master protocol — the closest thing to a purpose-built cellular-therapy home for this disease — that still cannot take a G12R tumor because its three lead products cover G12V and G12D. If Anocca's library adds a G12R/HLA product this becomes a priority re-screen, which is a concrete reason to bank the HLA type now.

indication: KRAS G12V-mutated pancreatic, cholangiocarcinoma, CRC, NSCLC (UPenn)
biomarker: KRAS G12V plus HLA-A*11:01 required — patient is G12R: excluded on allele
design: Phase 1 of TCR1188-ABC base-edited autologous TCR-T with anti-ILT4 scFv armor, single infusion after Flu/Cy
inclusion_match_notes: Third data point in the same finding: US academic mKRAS TCR-T is advancing (here with base-editing and ILT4 armoring) but on G12V/G12D restrictions, leaving G12R without a cellular-therapy option. No enrollment path for this patient; surfaced as a coverage gap, not an oversight.

indication: Locally advanced/metastatic solid tumors with TP53 Y220C (PYNNACLE)
biomarker: TP53 Y220C required; PHASE 2 MONOTHERAPY EXCLUDES ANY KNOWN KRAS SNV — the patient's G12R closes the registrational cohort
design: Phase 1/2: published phase 1 dose escalation (n=77, RP2D 2000 mg QD with food); registrational phase 2 monotherapy plus phase 1b pembrolizumab combination ongoing
intervention_dosing: 2000 mg PO once daily with food (RP2D)
inclusion_match_notes: The tumor carries the exact variant this drug was built for, but the registrational phase 2 monotherapy cohort excludes any known KRAS single-nucleotide variant, and G12R is one — so the headline pathway is closed to this patient as the protocol stands. The phase 1b rezatapopt-plus-pembrolizumab arm carries no KRAS exclusion and remains formally reachable, though MSS/TMB-low biology weakens the checkpoint half of that combination. Confirming Y220C persistence in the recurrence (ctDNA acceptable per companion protocols NCT06616636/NCT07372625) is the cheap preparatory step either way.

indication: Advanced solid tumors with TP53 Y220C mutation
line: 2L+ (≥1 prior line of systemic therapy for tumor type and stage)
biomarker: Documented TP53 Y220C; no KRAS co-mutation exclusion appears in the registry record
design: Phase 1/2a dose escalation and expansion of JAB-30355 monotherapy
inclusion_match_notes: With the PYNNACLE monotherapy cohort blocked by the KRAS G12R co-mutation, this US-recruiting Y220C reactivator — whose registry criteria carry no KRAS exclusion — becomes the practical front-runner on the Y220C axis; confirm the absence of a protocol-level KRAS rule with the sponsor before screening. The ≥1-prior-line requirement reads as met given ten perioperative FOLFIRINOX cycles and progression. LVEF ≤50% is exclusionary, so get the baseline echo the organ-function work-up already contemplates.

indication: Advanced solid tumors with TP53 Y220C mutation
biomarker: TP53 Y220C; no KRAS co-mutation exclusion in registry
design: Phase 1/2a dose escalation and expansion of NTS071 monotherapy
inclusion_match_notes: Second US-recruiting Y220C option without a registry-level KRAS exclusion, giving the Y220C axis redundancy if either sponsor's full protocol turns out stricter than its registry text. Prior-toxicity resolution to ≤ grade 1 is required, which makes grading the residual oxaliplatin neuropathy a screening prerequisite here.

indication: Solid tumors harboring a TP53 Y220C mutation (China)
biomarker: Confirmed TP53 Y220C in tumor tissue; prior Y220C-reactivator exposure excluded
design: First-in-human phase 1 of GenSci128 tablets
inclusion_match_notes: Y220C-gated and free of a KRAS exclusion, but China-based and behind the two US reactivators on both access and information; its sensory-neuropathy carve-out (grade ≤2 tolerated) is friendlier than most. Third choice on this axis.

indication: Advanced solid malignancies with TP53 Y220C mutation
line: 2L+ (progression on most recent line; refractory to or without standard options)
biomarker: TP53 Y220C
design: Phase 1/2 dose escalation of LG00313112 once daily
inclusion_match_notes: Not yet open and without listed sites; logged so the Y220C roster is complete and re-screenable. A December 2026 start is posted, which could line up with a later line of therapy for this patient.

indication: MSI-H/dMMR or TMB-H (≥10 mut/Mb) advanced solid tumors (KEYNOTE-158 basket)
biomarker: Requires MSI-H/dMMR or TMB ≥10 mut/Mb — this tumor is MSS with TMB 0.83: biomarker-excluded
design: Phase 2 multi-cohort basket of pembrolizumab monotherapy; basis of the tumor-agnostic MSI-H and TMB-H approvals
inclusion_match_notes: Recorded as excluded-on-biomarker rather than silently dropped: MSS status and a TMB of 0.83 against the ≥10 threshold close the tumor-agnostic pembrolizumab routes, so single-agent checkpoint blockade has no biomarker support in this case. Immunotherapy interest should flow through the vaccine and cell-engager rows, whose mechanisms do not depend on mutational burden.

indication: Mesothelin-expressing solid tumors including pancreatic cancer (NCI)
line: 2L+ (progression on ≥1 approved systemic therapy; no line limit)
biomarker: Mesothelin 2+/3+ in ≥50% of cells by IHC on fresh or archival tissue — not yet measured in this patient
design: Phase 1 of TNhYP218 (naive/stem-cell-memory-enriched anti-mesothelin hYP218 CAR-T) after Flu/Cy
inclusion_match_notes: Mesothelin is not a nominated feature — it enters on the launching agent's instruction and on the survey's note that it is the unmeasured surface antigen most likely positive in PDAC (80-90% of cases). The 2+/3+ in ≥50% gate can be answered from the archival block via the IHC bundle already recommended, and the NCI accepts archival tissue. Everything else fits: PDAC named, ECOG 0-1, prior-therapy rule met under the post-adjuvant-progression reading.

indication: Previously treated advanced PDAC, CRC, and biliary tract cancer (MK-9999 GI umbrella)
biomarker: No TROP2 expression gate; TROP2 is broadly expressed in PDAC but unmeasured in this patient and not a nominated feature
design: Phase 1/2 umbrella, sacituzumab tirumotecan alone or in combinations, PDAC cohort included
inclusion_match_notes: Included at the launching agent's request as the most credible TROP2 route into PDAC: a previously-treated PDAC cohort with no expression cutoff, so the unmeasured TROP2 status is not an entry barrier. Rated weak because the mechanism ties to no nominated targetable feature — this is an antigen-class bet, not a biomarker match, and it sits behind the CLDN18.2 and RAS rows accordingly. Sac-TMT holds approvals in China in breast and lung indications, none in pancreatic cancer.

indication: CLDN18.2-positive advanced solid tumors — gastric/GEJ, pancreatic cancer, cholangiocarcinoma — after first-line failure or progression
biomarker: CLDN18.2 IHC membrane staining ≥2+ in ≥20% of tumor cells in at least one lesion — the patient's 2+/3+ in 60% clears this cutoff three times over
design: Single-center open-label first-in-human dose-escalation IIT of a single dose of 177Lu-labeled CLDN18.2-directed radioligand; estimated n=12
intervention_dosing: Single IV dose, escalating activity cohorts
inclusion_match_notes: The one modality in this file whose kill mechanism does not require antigen on every cell: beta crossfire from 177Lu reaches antigen-negative neighbors, so heterogeneous 2+/3+ staining in 60% of cells — a liability for the naked-antibody and CAR rows — matters far less here, and the protocol's own gate (≥2+ in ≥20%) is cleared with wide margin on the archival stain. Post-first-line progression, ECOG 0-1, and measurable disease all fit the recurrence picture; prior-treatment toxicity must be back to ≤ grade 2, which the ungraded oxaliplatin neuropathy likely satisfies but needs documenting. Practical limits are real: a 12-patient single-center IIT in China with dosimetry-heavy endpoints, so this is a travel-dependent early slot rather than an established pathway.

indication: CLDN18.2-positive gastric and pancreatic cancer
line: n/a (biodistribution/dosimetry; ≥2 weeks from last myelosuppressive treatment)
biomarker: CLDN18.2 expression required with ≥1 CLDN18.2-positive lesion; no numeric cutoff stated in the registry
design: Single-center first-in-human biodistribution and dosimetry study of a theranostic pair — [68Ga]-IR199 imaging plus a single dose of [131I]-IR199 therapeutic radioconjugate; estimated n=10
endpoint: Absorbed radiation dose in tumors and normal organs (SPECT/CT dosimetry)
inclusion_match_notes: Second live entry in the CLDN18.2 radioconjugate class, caught in the same corrective sweep: pancreatic cancer is a named population and the therapeutic isotope is 131I, but the primary endpoint is organ dosimetry from a single administration rather than treatment effect, and no expression cutoff is published. Kept so the board sees the class has two independent clinical programs, both China-based; as a treatment option it sits behind the 177Lu-DOTA-SNA040 study on every axis.
